player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in a game of Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; you see only the opponent's card.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) each round, {max_rounds} round(s) total.
- Valid moves: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X is a positive integer <= your chip count.)
- Highest hidden card wins the pot at showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet/Raise kungәna dә mbu ro waljin.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Awo bowotiyin ba; nyiye raksa [check] ro waljin.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Kǝla [bet X] lan faidatә baditaro; bet laa gәnyi.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: indiso {card}. Pot split  ndasowosoye kǝla nza lan gǝrjin {split}.

outcome.draw: Chipwa tilo ngawo awoa rowata sammaben.
